# MissileGenerated — Simulink → Embedded Coder output

This tree holds the C source and headers generated by
[missile-mbd](https://github.com/abdullahabduljabbarab/missile-mbd)'s
`rtwbuild('missile')`. Nothing in this folder is authored by hand;
regenerate from the standalone Simulink model whenever the model
changes.

## Layout

```
MissileGenerated/
├── include/               <-- headers, added to PublicIncludePaths
│   ├── missile.h
│   ├── missile_types.h
│   ├── missile_private.h
│   ├── rtwtypes.h
│   ├── rtGetInf.h
│   └── rt_nonfinite.h
└── src/                   <-- sources, compiled via Private/MissileGeneratedUnit.cpp
    ├── missile.c
    ├── rtGetInf.c
    └── rt_nonfinite.c
```

## Regeneration workflow

1. In MATLAB, from the `missile-mbd` repo root:
   ```matlab
   addpath(genpath(pwd))
   build_missile_model               % construct missile.slx
   run('model/missile_params.m')     % load params into base workspace
   configure_reusable_function       % set Embedded Coder options
   rtwbuild('missile')               % generate C into missile_ert_rtw/
   ```
2. Copy the following into `ClearanceSim/ThirdParty/MissileGenerated/`:
   - `missile_ert_rtw/missile.h`          → `include/`
   - `missile_ert_rtw/missile_types.h`    → `include/`
   - `missile_ert_rtw/missile_private.h`  → `include/`
   - `missile_ert_rtw/rtwtypes.h`         → `include/`
   - `missile_ert_rtw/rtGetInf.h`         → `include/`
   - `missile_ert_rtw/rt_nonfinite.h`     → `include/`
   - `missile_ert_rtw/missile.c`          → `src/`
   - `missile_ert_rtw/rtGetInf.c`         → `src/`
   - `missile_ert_rtw/rt_nonfinite.c`     → `src/`
3. Rebuild the CLEARANCE solution. `ClearanceMissileMBD.Build.cs`
   auto-detects the presence of `include/` and flips
   `CLEARANCE_MISSILE_MBD_HAVE_CODEGEN=1`, switching `FMissileWrapper`
   from its pursuit stub to the real generated model transparently.

## Why not git-track the generated tree

It IS tracked — the whole point is that the CLEARANCE build must never
depend on a local MATLAB install. Committing the generated C means any
runner (CI, another dev, a fresh clone) can build CLEARANCE without ever
touching Simulink.

## What NOT to edit here

Every `.c` and `.h` under `include/` and `src/` is machine-generated.
Manual edits will be lost on the next `rtwbuild`. Fix the Simulink model
in the `missile-mbd` repo and regenerate.
